# Salt and Sun Tours

> Tour operator based in Walvis Bay, Namibia, running day tours, shorter
> adventure activities, multi-day self-drive journeys, and standalone
> point-to-point transport around Swakopmund and Walvis Bay. Real
> replies from a human team in Swakopmund, not automated booking
> confirmations — no fixed online pricing, quotes are worked out per
> enquiry based on group size and itinerary.

Contact: bookings@saltandsuntours.com.na · +264 81 824 2282 /
+264 81 754 0940 · 1st Street East, Walvis Bay, Namibia.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/): Overview of all tours, adventures, and journeys.
- [Tours](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/tours): Eleven signature full-day tours across Namibia's desert, coast, and wildlife regions — Etosha, Sossusvlei, Skeleton Coast, Sandwich Harbour, Spitzkoppe, Pelican Point, Moonlandscape, Cape Cross, Living Desert, Dolphin & Seal Catamaran Cruise, and the Township Tour.
- [Adventures](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/adventures): Shorter, activity-based excursions around Swakopmund and Walvis Bay — quad biking, sandboarding, skydiving, paragliding, kayaking, fishing, camel rides, go-karting, mini golf, and a trampoline park.
- [Journeys](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/journeys): Multi-day, multi-location self-drive itineraries across Namibia, planned day by day.
- [Booking](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/booking): Request a tour, adventure, journey, custom combo, or transport-only booking.
- [Gallery](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/gallery): Photos from past tours.
- [FAQ](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/faq): Answers to common booking and Namibia-travel questions.
- [Contact](https://saltandsuntours.com.na/contact): General enquiries.
